main.description: A vouch on the Atlas of Care: an affirmation of one thing someone else has said they do. It lives in the voucher's repo and holds nothing but a pointer to that statement as it stood. The atlas shows it only while the statement is on the map and unchanged.

atlas.description: The atlas this vouch is for. The backlink index finds vouches by this field.

subject.description: The statement vouched for: its at-uri and content hash.
